defects.where: menu.pdf 300dpi crop-1-2 / crop-2-2, right end of every dot leader
defects.what: Leaders end in a squeezed partial dot (doubled dot at the end), so the run does not stop cleanly before the price gap
Cream panel and amber left bar break out of the content column asymmetrically (extends further left than right of the price column); reads slightly off-grid
Hairline section rules render at visibly different weights at screen/150 dpi (BAKERY rule looks grey and thinner than COFFEE/TEA) because they sit on fractional positions
Small sun-over-waves glyph is a generic token, very small relative to the title
Type3 fonts; headings extract as 'C O F F E E' and ff/fi ligatures as ligature glyphs, so copy/search of the PDF text is slightly degraded

AOSO.craft_notes: Polished, conventional menu: navy masthead with cream serif title and amber italic tagline, tracked sans section heads with amber rules, serif items with tabular, decimal-aligned and right-aligned prices, amber dietary tags in small caps-like sans (9.5 pt), tinted seasonal panel with italic descriptions, footer band. Clear hierarchy and good rhythm; everything at or above 9 pt and inside a 0.5 in frame on white, so it prints on a desktop printer. Only small refinements needed (leader ends, seasonal panel alignment).
AOSO.revision_notes: All coffee prices +$0.25 (Espresso $3.25 ... Drip coffee $3.00), Drip refill removed, 'Oat milk +$0.75' added under the Coffee list as a small italic note aligned to the price column (11 pt). Lower sections moved up a few pixels as the layout reflowed; style, colours and all other copy unchanged (apparent rule-weight differences are rasterisation of the same amber hairline).

fidelity_misses: Prices are decimal-aligned but not right-aligned: with proportional figures the right edge of the price column is ragged ($4.75, $1.00, $5.25 end short of $3.00)
Cream background fills the whole page to the trim edge, which a 'no bleed' desktop print cannot reproduce (white unprinted rim will show)

defects.where: menu-preview crop-1-1 and crop-2-1, every section heading
defects.what: Amber rule sits directly under the heading baseline and directly on top of the first item's cap height, with no breathing room; heading, rule and first row crowd together
Heading rule starts a few points left of the heading and item text, so the left edge is not aligned
Ragged right edge of prices (proportional digits; $1.00 indented, $4.75/$5.25 short)
Full-page cream fill to the trim edge on a no-bleed desktop print; the inset navy/amber double frame will sit inside an uneven white printer margin
Hours/address line runs nearly the full width of the frame, wider than the menu column above it
Large dead bands between sections versus no gap between heading and items; vertical rhythm is uneven

FKJR.craft_notes: Clean and legible: DM Serif Display title and condensed caps section heads with DM Sans body, navy on cream, amber rules and a double inset frame. But the heading/rule/first-row stacking is cramped while the gaps between sections are oversized, tags are plain text, and the price column is ragged on the right. Pleasant but generic; several typographic fixes needed before printing.
FKJR.revision_notes: All coffee prices +$0.25, Drip refill removed, 'Oat milk +$0.75' added as a small grey left-aligned note under Drip coffee (11.5 pt). Changes are confined to the Coffee block; the Tea section and everything below did not move (the note sits in the former gap, so the Coffee-to-Tea gap is now a little smaller than the others). No other drift.

pairwise_round1.why: AOSO has a clear masthead, well-spaced sections and a true right/decimal-aligned price column, while FKJR crowds each heading rule against its first item and leaves the prices ragged.
